works.author: Yasir Noori
works.comment: 深色金融质感，数据卡片层级干净，投资类 App 的信息密度和配色可直接参考。
works.comment_en: Dark, premium fintech feel with clean data-card hierarchy — a solid reference for info density and color in investment apps.
works.title: Mobile App for an Investment Product ✦ Univest

works.author: SM Rubel ✦
works.comment: 训练计划卡片配进度环，AI 个性化推荐落到界面的方式值得借鉴。
works.comment_en: Workout plan cards paired with progress rings — a nice example of how AI personalization lands in the UI.
works.title: AI Fitness App UI – Personalized Workout & Fitness Tracking

works.author: Ilias Miah
works.comment: AI Agent 指挥中心概念稿，风险/合规状态的可视化排布，agent 类产品后台可参考。
works.comment_en: An AI agent command-center concept; the way risk and compliance states are laid out is worth studying for agent dashboards.
works.title: Mandate — AI Agent Command Center | Risk & Compliance

works.author: Korsa
works.comment: fintech 落地页，hero 区信息架构紧凑不乱，SaaS 落地页排版可借鉴。
works.comment_en: Fintech landing page with a tight, uncluttered hero — good layout reference for SaaS pages.
works.title: Kova - Fintech SaaS Landing Page

works.author: Bato UI/UX
works.comment: 服装电商首页概念，大图与商品流的节奏感好，DTC 品牌站首页可参考。
works.comment_en: Fashion e-commerce homepage concept; the rhythm between hero imagery and the product feed is spot-on — a good DTC homepage reference.
works.title: E-Commerce Fashion Website Home Page Concept

works.author: NexUX Product
works.comment: 收入分析看板，图表密度和筛选器布局处理得干净，你最近重构 dashboard，这个可以直接抄作业。
works.comment_en: Revenue analytics dashboard with clean chart density and filter layout — and since you're refactoring your dashboard, this one's worth stealing outright.
works.title: SaaS Revenue Analytics Dashboard
